title: fagara lutea
intro: Fagara lutea, commonly known as Chinese prickly ash, is a plant species in the genus Zanthoxylum. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which help to reduce pain and fever, as well as aid in digestion and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Fagara lutea include analgesic, anti-asthmatic, and anti-rheumatic effects, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, such as berberine, which contribute to its medicinal properties. These properties make Fagara lutea a valuable resource in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is often used to treat various health conditions.
